description: Partial change of use of ground floor from commercial (Class E) to residential (Class C3); erection of an additional floor at roof level, including raising the height of parapet wall to the front, side and rear, installation of 3no. solar PV panels on top of the flat roof and a rooflight above the stairwell; erection of a single storey rear extension incorporating replacement of part of existing wall with perforated brick wall and a bin store fronting Bramber Road; installation of a new residential entrance door at ground floor level, following the demolition of the existing single storey rear extension, and installation of a new window and repositioning of an existing window at first floor level fronting Bramber Road; and associated works.
